message.content: The Eiffel Tower is repainted roughly every 7–8 years, and each full‑tower repaint takes about **two months** of work. That’s because the tower’s metal structure is covered with a protective paint coat that needs to be applied in layers, dried, inspected, and then finished. In practice, the maintenance crew works in shifts around the clock, so the actual calendar time is only a couple of months, even though the process involves many stages of preparation, application, and quality control.
